Verify pass completed. The prior inventory is usable as a draft, but I would apply these corrections before treating it as the final reference inventory:

1. **Nhơn Trạch 3 and Nhơn Trạch 4 status should be changed from Construction to Operating.**  
   - PV Power’s later source says Nhơn Trạch 3 reached commercial operation on **21 Nov 2025** and Nhơn Trạch 4 on **17 Dec 2025**; another PV Power source says the combined project officially entered commercial operation on **5 Jan 2026**. Use the unit-level CODs in the COD column and “Operating” with status as-of **7 Jan 2026** or **PV Power AGM report, May 2026**. ([pvpower.vn](https://pvpower.vn/vi/post/pv-power-vuot-ke-hoach-loi-nhuan-nam-thu-7-lien-tiep--dat-muc-tieu-doanh-thu-gan-50-000-ty-dong-trong-nam-2026-6909.htm?utm_source=openai))

2. **Quảng Trạch I remains Construction, not Operating.**  
   - EVN reported first grid synchronization of unit 1 at **12:00 on 12 Apr 2026**, but explicitly said this was a step toward acceptance and commercial generation. A later EVN update says the target was commercial operation for unit 1 in **July 2026** and unit 2 in **October 2026**. ([evn.com.vn](https://www.evn.com.vn/d/vi-VN/news/-To-may-1-Nha-may-Nhiet-dien-Quang-Trach-I-hoa-luoi-lan-dau-thanh-cong-60-12-507634?utm_source=openai))

3. **Quảng Trạch II LNG should be upgraded from Permitted/Pre-permit ambiguity to Construction or at least Permitted depending on row-rule strictness.**  
   - EVN says the EPC contract for LNG Quảng Trạch II became effective in **March 2026**, with planned generation in **2030**. If “EPC underway” is sufficient under the user’s definition, mark **Construction**, status as-of **15 May 2026**. ([evn.com.vn](https://www.evn.com.vn/d/vi-VN/news/Nha-may-Nhiet-dien-Quang-Trach-1-Tang-toc-de-phat-dien-thuong-mai-to-may-1-trong-thang-7-60-13-508051?utm_source=openai))

4. **MOIT Decision 1509/QĐ-BCT dated 30 May 2025 should supersede original PDP8 Annex II for future project schedule rows.**  
   - It implements adjusted PDP8 under Decision 768/QĐ-TTg and lists the current priority LNG, coal, domestic-gas, cogeneration, and reserve project schedules. It should be Source 1 for most future/planned/shelved/cancelled rows. ([moit.gov.vn](https://moit.gov.vn/tin-tuc/phat-trien-nang-luong/bo-cong-thuong-ban-hanh-ke-hoach-trien-khai-quy-hoach-dien-viii-dieu-chinh.html?utm_source=openai))

5. **Rows with “Retired” based only on PDP retirement schedules should be downgraded unless direct retirement/decommissioning evidence is found.**  
   - Affected: Uông Bí I, Ninh Bình, Cần Thơ gas turbine, Thủ Đức gas/oil, Hiệp Phước existing plant. Best status may be **Retired / MEDIUM or LOW** with notes saying “scheduled retirement; direct closure source not retrieved.”

6. **Technology confidence should be separated mentally from row confidence.**  
   - Several rows are HIGH for existence/status/capacity but only MEDIUM/LOW for coal technology if no boiler-cycle primary source was retrieved. If final precision matters, mark Notes: “technology inferred from project class; not explicitly stated in cited source.”

7. **Industrial/cogeneration boundary rows need explicit caveats.**  
   - Hải Hà, Formosa HT2, Hòa Phát II, Đức Giang, VNT19-type rows are in MOIT source annexes but not cleanly within “coal/domestic gas/imported LNG.” Keep only if interpreting “thermal generation assets” broadly; otherwise move them to explanatory notes or mark LOW/MEDIUM with fuel caveats.

8. **The prior response violated the requested final form in one important way:** it included many rows with web citation syntax in Source fields/notes rather than plain source names. For a polished final document, Source 1/Source 2 cells should contain short source labels, while full URLs belong only in the bibliography.

Given remaining budget, I would not attempt another full 90+ row table rewrite unless required. The highest-value corrections are the three current-status updates above: **Nhơn Trạch 3/4 Operating**, **Quảng Trạch I still Construction**, and **Quảng Trạch II LNG EPC effective / Construction if EPC-underway rule is applied**.
